title: PRE-A0 Shadow Operations
description: Operational dashboard for PRE-A0 shadow scoring and the isolated A0-Fast worker: readiness, live input, inference quality, persistence, outputs, and guardrails.

panels.title: PRE-A0 Shadow Operations
panels.description: Scope, safety boundary, and direct operational links.

options.content:
**Unconfirmed early-warning shadow.** This dashboard is operational evidence only; PRE-A0 is not a confirmed A0 signal and must remain fail-closed. Start with readiness and active alerts, then follow the data path into inference quality and persistence.

**Quick links:** [Railway logs](https://railway.com/project/0616a3b7-7b7f-41d1-8fac-a0b8922c94ca/service/743407dc-0926-4a94-a98d-87b5ade67f37/logs?environmentId=470fbd0f-894d-46cd-8722-6b072d255d99) · [Railway deployments](https://railway.com/project/0616a3b7-7b7f-41d1-8fac-a0b8922c94ca/service/743407dc-0926-4a94-a98d-87b5ade67f37/deployments?environmentId=470fbd0f-894d-46cd-8722-6b072d255d99) · [PRE-A0 alerts](/alerting/list?search=PRE-A0) · [Runbook](https://github.com/skipp-dev/skipp-algo/blob/main/docs/pre_a0_rollout_runbook.md)

panels.title: Status at a Glance
panels.description: Immediate readiness of telemetry, model, calibration, and the A0-Fast stream.

panels.title: Control Plane Readiness
panels.description: CONTROL READY requires PRE-A0 enabled, model ready, calibration valid, and the A0-Fast stream connected. It does not claim that records are being processed or that inference and persistence are active; verify the Live Data Path separately.

panels.title: Active Grafana Alerts
panels.description: Firing, pending, recovering, and error-state Grafana-managed alerts from the PRE-A0 folder only.

panels.title: PRE-A0 Mode
panels.description: Whether PRE-A0 shadow scoring is enabled in the isolated A0-Fast worker.

panels.title: Model
panels.description: Fail-closed model contract status after artifact identity and validity checks.

panels.title: Calibration
panels.description: Whether the loaded model exposes a compatible calibration contract.

panels.title: A0-Fast Stream
panels.description: Databento stream connection used by the isolated shadow worker.

panels.title: Loaded Model Identity
panels.description: Live model status, artifact ID, and calibration version from pre_a0_model_info. The panel name is the evidence; the numeric value is always 1.

panels.title: Last Disconnect Reason
panels.description: Most recently recorded A0-Fast stream disconnect reason; none means no disconnect in this process lifetime.

panels.title: Live Data Path
panels.description: Input freshness, queue pressure, processing throughput, and shadow persistence.

panels.title: Last Record Age
panels.description: Seconds since the worker received its most recent Databento record; red above 8 seconds.

panels.title: Queue Utilization
panels.description: Current bounded-queue depth divided by capacity; warning at 50%, red at 80%.

panels.title: Records Received
panels.description: Databento records received per second over the last five minutes.

panels.title: Records Processed
panels.description: Records consumed by the A0-Fast decision path per second over five minutes.

panels.title: Shadow Snapshots
panels.description: PRE-A0 snapshots recorded per second over five minutes; zero is expected before scoring starts.

panels.title: A0-Fast Decisions
panels.description: Confirmed core-only A0-Fast shadow decisions per hour; separate from PRE-A0 estimates.

panels.title: Input and Processing Throughput
panels.description: Five-minute rates for records received, processed, and rejected by reason. A sustained gap now identifies whether input is rejected or the decision path is not consuming it.

panels.title: Queue Depth and High-Water Mark
panels.description: Current queue depth, configured capacity, and the process-lifetime high-water mark.

panels.title: Inference, Quality, and Shadow Outputs
panels.description: Model execution, feature-contract violations, early-warning states, scores, alerts, and outcomes.

panels.title: Inference Throughput
panels.description: PRE-A0 model inferences per second over five minutes.

panels.title: Mean Inference Latency
panels.description: Five-minute mean model inference time; empty until at least one inference occurs.

panels.title: Input Contract Violations
panels.description: Missing plus out-of-range features during the last 15 minutes; red above the alert threshold of 10.

panels.title: Runtime Integrity Errors
panels.description: Inference, duplicate-decision, and persistence errors during the last five minutes.

panels.title: Feature Contract Violations
panels.description: Five-minute rates of missing and out-of-range model inputs.

panels.title: Inference and Persistence Activity
panels.description: Five-minute rates for inference execution, snapshots recorded, and snapshot rows flushed.

panels.title: PRE-A0 Estimates by State
panels.description: Estimate rate by shadow state. This panel becomes populated when live PRE-A0 estimates are recorded.

panels.title: Score Buckets by Horizon
panels.description: Scored probabilities by configured horizon and decile bucket; unavailable scores use their own bucket.

panels.title: PRE-A0 Alerts by Direction
panels.description: Operator-visible PRE-A0 alert events by horizon and direction; empty in pure shadow mode is valid.

panels.title: Observed Outcomes
panels.description: Recorded PRE-A0 outcomes by horizon and outcome label, used for shadow calibration evidence.

panels.title: Runtime Resilience
panels.description: Queue safety, recovery state, process resources, and transport throughput.

panels.title: Queue Drops (15m)
panels.description: Bars dropped by the bounded queue; any drop forces fail-closed reconstruction.

panels.title: Disconnects (1h)
panels.description: Stream disconnects during the last hour; each disconnect invalidates symbol state until recovery.

panels.title: Resync Required
panels.description: Symbols blocked until a complete historical reconstruction proves continuity.

panels.title: Peak RSS
panels.description: Process peak resident memory reported by the A0-Fast worker.

panels.title: Wire Throughput
panels.description: Estimated Databento wire bytes received per second over five minutes.

panels.title: Worker Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the A0-Fast worker process started.

panels.title: Stream Freshness
panels.description: Age of the newest received Databento record; warning and alert budgets are 5 and 8 seconds.

panels.title: Disconnect, Drop, and Recovery Events
panels.description: Five-minute event rates for disconnects, queue drops, and reconstruction outcomes.

panels.title: Process CPU Usage
panels.description: Five-minute rate of process CPU seconds; 1.0 corresponds to one fully used CPU core.

panels.title: Promotion Guardrails
panels.description: Evidence and integrity counters. Green is necessary for review but never sufficient for promotion.

panels.title: Inference Errors (24h)
panels.description: Model inference errors during the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Input Violations (24h)
panels.description: Missing and out-of-range feature observations during the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Persistence Integrity (24h)
panels.description: Persistence failures plus duplicate decision IDs during the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Alert Budget Breaches (24h)
panels.description: PRE-A0 hourly alert-budget breaches during the last 24 hours.

panels.title: How to Read Promotion Readiness
panels.description: Human interpretation and the non-automatic promotion boundary.

options.content: **This dashboard does not approve promotion.** Before any move beyond shadow, require non-zero shadow snapshots and outcomes, stable calibration, zero critical integrity errors, acceptable missingness, bounded alert volume, and the explicit promotion checklist in the runbook. If telemetry disappears or any integrity tile turns red, keep PRE-A0 fail-closed and investigate.
